(4x). 7) Semantic tagging error: '<VOLUME>8e Exempla politica</VOLUME>' is an OCR misreading of the ampersand in Lipsius' work 'Monita et Exempla politica'; it is not a volume statement, so it was merged into the title as 'Monita & Exempla politica'. 8) Added tag where it makes sense: 'apud Plautin.' (the Plantin press, Antwerp/Leiden) is a publisher statement to which the later 'ibid.' references refer, so it was wrapped in <PUBLISHER>, paralleling the existing <PLACE>Lugd.</PLACE>.
